title: TR-Core: Autonomous Symbolic Induction of Compositional Rules
description:
Experimental data from TR-Core (Tabula Rasa Core) — a formal experimentation framework for studying autonomous symbolic induction of compositional rules from experience.

Includes:
- Phase 3 results: 24 seeds × 2 replications, rare compositional rules (8 attributes, 4608 contexts)
- Phase 4 results: 24 seeds × 2 replications, Structural-OOD generalization (held-out triple)
- Analysis: paired permutation tests, Cohen's dz, bootstrap 95% CI
- Publication-ready figures (PDF + PNG)

Key finding: COMPOSE operation is necessary and sufficient for structural-OOD generalization (0.96–1.00 held-out accuracy vs chance for ablations).

Paper: https://osf.io/ruvjg
Code: https://github.com/Mardon-programm/tabula-rasa-core
Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23619568
